findings.title: Final accounting or CUDA synchronization failure can preserve successful qualification
findings.source_condition: A twin is marked COMPLETE before meter.receipt; receipt exceptions record an error without clearing COMPLETE. The family gate ignores accounting errors. Top-level GPU receipt collection similarly leaves PASS/checks true and exit code only checks the Boolean. Receipt begins with CUDA synchronize.
findings.required_repair: In a preserved sealed successor, make required accounting collection and synchronization part of twin/stage/family success; record errors and partial data, but force non-pass status and checks false on accounting or caught runtime failure. Require a valid final pass status as well as checks for exit zero.
findings.suggested_later_verification: Failure-inject receipt collection without scope reduction; verify retained error/partial counters, non-pass statuses/checks and nonzero exit. Reviewer did not execute such a test.

source_assessments.own_pool_meaning: Only member-specific clamped completion weights versus arithmetic mean of clamped weights changes; own transformed features/nonlinear decoder and mean-raw-logit serving remain.
source_assessments.arithmetic_order_limit: Native common+right+left and portable common+left+right are mathematically equal but need the prospective GPU tolerance gate, not a bitwise source equality claim.
source_assessments.native_exception_limit: Native structurally exceptional helper cases are not repaired; full-scale reference failure must be retained without skipping.

nonblocking_limits_and_root_conditions.condition: v1 runtime identity omits root's shared-library binary hash inventory. Exact binary continuity requires root immutable-environment/custody enforcement or successor checks; no binary change is alleged.

Preflight occurs outside runtime receipt try and before output creation; refused/malformed/source-invalid admissions can leave no QUALIFICATION.json. Root must retain concrete launcher output separately.
Total process number excludes final qualification-report write. Internal state writes are timed; hidden serialization/sparse/sampler transfer counts are opaque though elapsed latency is charged.
CUDA peaks include resident full data/live state after per-twin reset; Linux host RSS is cumulative process high-water mark. Nested inclusive times cannot be summed as disjoint work.

Full GPU candidate counts, arithmetic, memory, finite complete epochs and serialization success are prospective runtime facts. A full-scale failure must be retained without rescue; source/CPU QA cannot certify feasibility.

Own versus pool is an association control in a shared/factorized composition. Native independent NCNC already preserves its own weights/decoder association. No new completion primitive, novelty, calibration or predictive advantage is established.
